# ParticleDrawState

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · struct

```csharp
public readonly struct ParticleDrawState
```

A particle as it's drawn: everything the system works out for it (where it is, how big, which way, what color, how old), for a [`ParticleRenderer`](ParticleRenderer.md) to turn into pixels.

## Properties

### AgeSeconds

```csharp
public float AgeSeconds { get; }
```

How long it's lived, in seconds.

### Color

```csharp

```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

Its premultiplied color, after its color change, opacity, the system's draw tint, and its effect's blend: an additive particle's alpha is 0.
